item.title: Shapovalov 'had to come out on fire' to beat Tsitsipas in battle of former Top-10 stars
item.description: Denis Shapovalov’s reaction said it all Wednesday evening in Indian Wells. The Canadian was thrilled after battling past Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-2, 3-6, 6-4 to win a clash of former Top-10 stars and reach the second round of the BNP Paribas Open. “Definitely never easy to draw a guy like Stefanos first round. item.title: Dimitrov delivers to set Alcaraz showdown at Indian Wells
item.description: Grigor Dimitrov seized revenge and a blockbuster opportunity in one stroke on Thursday at the BNP Paribas Open, where he overcame Terence Atmane 6-4, 5-7, 6-4 to line up a heavyweight Indian Wells clash with top seed Carlos Alcaraz. The 34-year-old Bulgarian avenged a defeat to Atmane from just eight days ago in Acapulco, rallying from a frustrating end to the second set to close out the match in three.
